topPRs.title: refactor: migrate Next.js → Vite SPA + Hono Workers (squash of shaw/refactor)
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Squash of [`shaw/refactor`](https://github.com/elizaOS/cloud/tree/shaw/refactor) onto `develop`. **1,260 files changed, +134,789 / −4,539.** Single commit, clean fast-forward of `develop`'s tip (`ce886784f`).

The branch had diverged ~4.4K commits from develop in both directions, with conflicts in 236 files. Rather than weaving thousands of micro-conflicts through a normal merge, we squashed shaw/refactor's tree on top of develop and auto-resolved overlap with `-X theirs` (shaw/refactor wins on text conflicts) — the new architecture is what we want everywhere it overlaps with develop's older shape. develop's NEW files (services/operator/*, OpenRouter pricing work, etc.) survived untouched on top.

## What this brings in from `shaw/refactor`

**Architectural cutover:**
- Next.js App Router → **Vite + React Router SPA** (`apps/frontend/`)
- API routes: Next-shape handlers → **Hono Workers** (`apps/api/`), auto-mounted via `apps/api/src/_router.generated.ts`
- Workspace restructure: `packages/apps/* → apps/*`
- Legacy `app/...` Next.js tree removed (intentional deletion preserved through the merge)

**SPA dashboard build-out** (every legacy `/dashboard/*` ported):
- 28 new pages under `apps/frontend/src/dashboard/**/Page.tsx` + 4 layouts (admin, chat-build, api-explorer, dashboard)
- 17 new typed data hooks under `apps/frontend/src/lib/data/*` (admin, affiliates, agents, analytics, api-keys, apps, chat, containers, credits, earnings, gallery, invoices, knowledge, mcps, milady, organizations, voices)
- All routes wired in `apps/frontend/src/App.tsx` with hover-preload via `lazyWithPreload`

**New Worker routes (Hono, codegen-mounted):**
- `POST /api/billing/checkout/verify` — Stripe session-retrieve fallback for the success page (replaces the legacy server-side flow)
- `GET /api/analytics/breakdown` + `GET /api/analytics/projections` — full shape `AnalyticsPageClient` needs
- `GET /api/v1/video/usage` + `GET /api/v1/video/featured` — real data from `generations` table (no fixtures)
- `GET /api/v1/milady/agents/:agentId` — converted Next-shape → Hono (was previously unmounted, so all calls were silently 404'ing); now also exposes admin-only Docker / SSH / bridge fields gated on `adminService.isAdmin`

**Auth bug fix (the visible one):**
- `POST /api/auth/steward-session` previously returned `401 Invalid token` whether the token was actually invalid OR the Worker was missing `STEWARD_SESSION_SECRET`. `AuthTokenSync` couldn't tell, so on misconfigured Workers every login was instantly wiped from localStorage and the user bounced back to `/login`. Now: `503 server_secret_missing` for the config case, `401 invalid_token` for true revocations, and the client only clears localStorage on the latter.

**Visual / copy:**
- Landing hero: "Monetize your agents" / "Eliza Cloud is everything you need to bootstrap and monetize agents and AI apps" / single "Get Started Free" CTA
- Header padding fixed (logo + buttons no longer flush against the edge)
- Feature cards now have real backing against the gradient
- Footer: "ELIZA CLOUD" copyright (was MILADY), Token + Blog removed
- Footer no longer below the fold

## What survives from `develop`

The +121K lines on top of shaw/refactor's tree:
- `services/operator/*` (Pepr capabilities operator)
- OpenRouter pricing rewrite + provider refactor (PR #482, embedding pricing backfill, /endpoints route coverage)
- Other develop-only commits since the branch point

## Worth eyeballing during review

A handful of files where both branches edited the same spot heavily; `-X theirs` may have lost a develop-side tweak:

- `packages/lib/services/ai-pricing*.ts`, `packages/lib/services/model-catalog.ts` — develop's openrouter pricing work landed here
- `packages/lib/services/oauth/providers/oauth2.ts`
- `proxy.ts` (+251 lines net)

If openrouter pricing or oauth tokens break on the preview deploy, look here first.

## Test plan

- [ ] Cloudflare Pages PR preview deploys successfully
- [ ] `/` landing page renders with new hero copy + footer above the fold
- [ ] `/login` → sign in (any provider) → does NOT bounce back to `/login` (the `steward-session` 401 fix)
- [ ] `/dashboard/milady` mounts after login
- [ ] `/dashboard/analytics` renders with real `AnalyticsPageClient` (breakdown + projections)
- [ ] `/dashboard/billing/success?session_id=…` invokes the new verify endpoint and updates the credit balance
- [ ] `/dashboard/admin` is gated on admin role; admin Docker/SSH/bridge details show on `/dashboard/milady/agents/:id` for admins only
- [ ] OpenRouter pricing + provider routes still work on the preview (verify the develop-side work survived the squash)
- [ ] `bun run --cwd apps/frontend typecheck` clean for the changed paths
- [ ] `bun run --cwd apps/api codegen && bun run --cwd apps/api build` clean

## Notes for reviewers

- The original `shaw/refactor` branch is preserved on origin as a paper trail.
- A `.env.vercel.production` file with 197 production secrets had been accidentally committed earlier on `shaw/refactor`; it was scrubbed via `git filter-repo` before this PR, and `.env.vercel*` / `.env.staging*` are now in `.gitignore`. Per separate notification, all those secrets were rotated. This PR's history does not contain the file.

topPRs.title: Push develop to production
topPRs.author: odilitime
topPRs.body:
<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
> [!NOTE]
> **High Risk**
> High risk because it replaces the primary AI provider/routing layer (removing `@ai-sdk/gateway` and Vercel Gateway provider) and rewires chat, embeddings, image generation, pricing, and model-catalog flows, which can impact availability, billing accuracy, and model compatibility in production.
> 
> **Overview**
> **Moves the platform’s default AI routing from Vercel AI Gateway to OpenRouter.** Env/config/docs are updated to make `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` the principal provider, remove `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`, and treat `OPENAI_API_KEY`/`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` as *per-family* fallbacks.
> 
> **Rewires API routes and services to use the new provider abstraction.** Most `streamText`/`generateText` call sites switch from `gateway.languageModel(...)` to `getLanguageModel(...)`; chat/embeddings default billingSource changes to `openrouter`; model catalog refresh/detail/status now read from an OpenRouter-backed cache.
> 
> **Updates provider and pricing infrastructure.** Adds shared HTTP/error handling (`providerFetchWithTimeout`) plus new direct providers (`OpenAIDirectProvider`, `AnthropicDirectProvider`) used for 402/429 failover, removes `VercelGatewayProvider`, and adds model-id translation for OpenRouter prefix differences (xAI/Mistral) plus pricing catalog changes (OpenRouter-only refresh, embedding pricing fetched via `/models/{id}/endpoints`, and improved modality classification).
> 
> **Fixes CLI login getting stuck on stale auth.** Adds `clearStaleStewardSession()` and adjusts `/auth/cli-login` state handling so 401s surface as recoverable errors with a “Sign In Again” path instead of looping/loading forever.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit ce886784f6f573a6a5700a201433531ae3331524. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->

topPRs.title: refactor: replace Vercel AI Gateway with OpenRouter
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Eliminates the Vercel AI Gateway dependency entirely. OpenRouter becomes the principal AI provider for all non-Groq traffic. OpenAI direct and Anthropic direct providers wired as per-family failover targets when their API keys are configured.

**No legacy / no shims** — gateway code, env vars, env-validator branches, tests, and doc references all deleted in this PR. No backward-compat env aliasing.

## Why

Consolidate to a single non-Groq provider, drop the Vercel-managed proxy, simplify env configuration, and unify the pricing/catalog source.

## Decisions taken (with rationale)

- **OpenRouter primary.** Sole non-Groq path.
- **Per-family fallback** when an OpenAI/Anthropic direct key is set (OpenAI for `openai/*`, Anthropic for `anthropic/*`, via Anthropic's OpenAI-compat endpoint).
- **Drop the `/v1/responses` passthrough.** Always convert via AI SDK transform → chat/completions. OpenRouter's `/v1/responses` is still beta and the SSE-usage-extraction billing path is too risky to retain.
- **Align `models/catalog.ts` to OpenRouter format** (`x-ai/`, `mistralai/`). Breaking change accepted.

## Implementation phases (commits)

1. `feat(providers): add model-id translation layer for OpenRouter` — `xai/`→`x-ai/`, `mistral/`→`mistralai/`, transparent pass-through for the rest.
2. `refactor(providers): drop Vercel Gateway, OpenRouter primary + per-family fallback` — flip `getProvider()`/`getProviderForModelWithFallback()` and add `OpenAIDirectProvider` + `AnthropicDirectProvider`.
3. `refactor: migrate all @ai-sdk/gateway call sites to getLanguageModel` — 13 sites swapped (messages route, agents A2A/MCP, mcp tools, skills, services memory/seo/app-promotion/app-promotion-assets/app-builder/twitter-automation/room-title/connection-enforcement). Hardcoded `gpt-4o-mini` → `openai/gpt-4o-mini`.
4. `refactor(responses): drop /v1/responses passthrough, transform-only path` — deletes ~830 lines (`handleNativeResponsesPassthrough`, `wrapWithUsageExtraction`, etc.) and removes the optional `responses` method from `AIProvider`.
5. `refactor(moderation): drop Vercel Gateway backend, OpenAI-only` — moderation now hits OpenAI directly when `OPENAI_API_KEY` is set, else logs once and skips (still non-blocking).
6. `refactor(pricing): drop Vercel Gateway from pricing + align catalog ids to OR` — `PricingBillingSource` union drops `"gateway"`, adds `"anthropic"`. Catalog ids in `models/catalog.ts` realigned to `x-ai/` / `mistralai/`.
7. `chore: drop @ai-sdk/gateway dep + finalize env/docs/test cleanup` — `package.json`/`bun.lock`, `.env.example`, env-validator, README, deploy templates, e2e/test helpers all cleaned.
8. `fix(pricing): infer OpenRouter productFamily from output modality only` — bug found during smoke: a multimodal text model (e.g. `gpt-5.4-mini` accepting images) was misclassified as `image` and broke the pricing lookup. Now uses `architecture.output_modalities`.
9. `fix(pricing): backfill OpenRouter embedding pricing from /endpoints route` — OR's `/v1/models` omits embedding models; pricing only exposed via `/api/v1/models/{id}/endpoints`. Backfill at catalog-fetch time.
10. `feat(pricing): cover all OpenRouter-served embedding models, not just OpenAI` — extended to `text-embedding-ada-002` and `qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b` after live inventory check on OR.
11. `refactor(providers): clean pass — extract shared HTTP helper, consolidate types` — DRY out `fetchWithTimeout` into `_http.ts` shared by all 4 provider classes; consolidate the `ProviderHttpError` envelope; add unit tests for direct providers + fallback wiring; strip gateway-era WIP comments and a dead `mergeGatewayGroqPreferenceWithAnthropicCot` helper.

## Test plan

- [x] `bun run check-types` clean on touched files.
- [x] `bun run test:unit` — **1437 pass / 0 fail / 106 skip** (1543 tests across 97 files), including new `providers-direct.test.ts`, `providers-fallback.test.ts`, and extended `model-id-translation.test.ts`.
- [x] Local validation: `docker compose up -d` (postgres + redis + redis-rest), `bun run db:migrate` clean (no schema drift caused by this PR).
- [x] Live smoke against local dev server with **only `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`** set:
  - `POST /v1/chat/completions` `openai/gpt-5.4-mini` → ✅ "pong"
  - `POST /v1/chat/completions` `x-ai/grok-4` → ✅ "Pong! 😊" (translation `xai/`→`x-ai/` exercised)
  - `POST /v1/chat/completions` `anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5` → ✅ "Hi! 👋"
  - `POST /v1/chat/completions` streaming → ✅ SSE chunks
  - `POST /v1/embeddings` for all 4 OR-served embedding models → ✅ vectors
  - `POST /v1/responses` (anonymous) → ✅ output text
  - `GET /v1/models` → ✅ 367-model OpenRouter catalog
  - `POST /v1/models/status` → ✅ correctly resolves `x-ai/grok-4`, marks unavailable models
- [x] Final grep for residual gateway references → **zero matches** across `packages/`, `app/`, `db/`, `scripts/`, `deploy/`, `docs/`, env templates, README.

## Risks accepted

- OpenRouter is a single point of failure for non-OpenAI/non-Anthropic models (xAI, Google, Mistral, …); per-family fallback only covers `openai/*` and `anthropic/*`.
- OR uses provider-native tokenizers — recorded usage may diverge slightly from gateway-era numbers (~few %).
- Catalog ID change is a breaking change for any client that hardcoded `xai/grok-4` or `mistral/codestral`. Acceptable per "no legacy" decision.
- `/v1/responses` no longer supports native Responses-API-only features (custom tools, web_search, image_generation); clients that need those must use Chat Completions.

## Migration notes

- Set `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (required).
- Optional: `OPENAI_API_KEY` (enables OpenAI fallback + content moderation), `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (enables Anthropic fallback).
- Remove `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` / `VERCEL_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` from env — they are no longer read.

topPRs.title: fix(auth): unstick cli-login + auto-clear stale Steward tokens on 401
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Fixes the `/auth/cli-login` page hanging forever on "Loading… Preparing authentication" when localStorage holds a Steward (or Privy) token whose JWT decodes as non-expired but whose server-side session is gone (revoked, db reset, key rotation, or sign-out on another device). And makes the recovery automatic so the same class of bug can't trap users again.

Reproduced end-to-end against the deployed `https://www.elizacloud.ai`:

- localStorage had `steward_session_token` (still in the future per `exp`) but no valid server cookie.
- `useSessionAuth()` reported `authenticated=true` from the cached token.
- The page jumped to `status="loading"`, POSTed `/api/auth/cli-session/<id>/complete`, server returned 401.
- The catch set `status="error"`, but the prop-sync effect immediately reset it to `"loading"` because `initialStatus.status` was still `"loading"`.
- Completion effect re-fired the same failing request. Permanent spinner. No error visible. No way out short of opening DevTools.

## Commits

1. **`63fff7945` fix(cli-login): use Steward-aware session hook, preserve error state** — the unused `packages/ui` shared component (still used elsewhere; brought it up to parity).
2. **`d7d390f2c` fix(cli-login): gate on ready, preserve error state** — the actually-deployed `app/auth/cli-login/page.tsx`. Adds an `"initializing"` status so the page renders the fallback while `!ready`. Excludes `"error"` from the prop-sync effect's reset list. Adds a "Sign In Again" button on the error UI that routes through `/login` (Steward-aware, preserves `returnTo`).
3. **`fc97126fe` fix(auth): auto-clear stale Steward tokens on server 401** — the structural fix. Hooks the existing `StewardProvider.AuthTokenSync.syncToken` POST: when the server returns 401, wipe `steward_session_token`, `steward_refresh_token`, every `privy:*` localStorage key, DELETE the cookie, dispatch `steward-token-sync`. Also runs in cli-login's `/complete` 401 catch so "Sign In Again" lands on a clean slate. Exports `clearStaleStewardSession` so any other dead-end page can call it.

## Why only those two endpoints (not a global fetch interceptor)

`POST /api/auth/steward-session` and `POST /api/auth/cli-session/<id>/complete` authoritatively validate the Steward token. Their 401 means "this token is bad, period." Other 401s in the app (insufficient perms, missing org, tenant mismatch) shouldn't log the user out and need different handling.

## Test plan

- [x] `bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` — clean.
- [ ] On a stale-localStorage tab: page no longer hangs. AuthTokenSync auto-clears, page transitions to `waiting_auth`, "Sign In" routes to `/login`.
- [ ] On a fresh sign-in: cli-login completes normally and mints the API key.
- [ ] On a server-side revoked session: the next page load auto-clears local tokens.
